post.text:
TurboQuant (via turbovec) compresses embedding vectors for vector search/RAG—no model retraining needed.

Quick start:
```
pip install turbovec
from turbovec import TurboQuantIndex
import numpy as np

index = TurboQuantIndex(dim=1536, bit_width=4)
index.add(your_vectors) # float32 array
scores, idx = https://t.co/SwR1dRxjzq(query_vec, k=10)
```

Saves/loads indexes too. Integrates with LangChain/LlamaIndex. Perfect for that 31GB→4GB use case. 

For LLM KV-cache version, check vLLM community forks.
